english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone does something without a companion.
Use 一個人 as the all-purpose spoken choice when someone does something solo, without saying that help was refused.

examples.english: I go to the movies solo.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 tai2 hei3

examples.english: Going to watch a movie alone is quite relaxing.
examples.traditional: 一個人去睇戲都幾自在。
examples.jyutping: jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 tai2 hei3 dou1 gei2 zi6 zoi6
